post_types.name: Course Launch Announcement
post_types.purpose: Open or promote a cohort with date, promise, outcomes, and registration CTA.

post_types.name: Interest Validation / Coming Soon
post_types.purpose: Test demand, announce that a course will happen, or collect early signups.

post_types.name: Course Positioning / FAQ Answer
post_types.purpose: Answer learner objections about fit, prerequisites, practicality, and logistics.

post_types.name: Module / Week Announcement
post_types.purpose: Tell learners what starts this week and what they will build or study.

post_types.name: Educational Micro-Lesson
post_types.purpose: Teach one course-relevant concept and softly connect it to course materials.

post_types.name: Opinion / Principle
post_types.purpose: State a course philosophy or counterintuitive technical stance.

post_types.name: Live Event / Workshop
post_types.purpose: Promote a live session, Q&A, office hour, or workshop connected to the course.

post_types.name: Resource / Materials Update
post_types.purpose: Announce or explain a repo, README, article, list, recording, or docs update.

post_types.name: Social Proof / Testimonial
post_types.purpose: Use learner stories, rankings, metrics, or reviews to prove value.

post_types.name: Project / Challenge / Competition
post_types.purpose: Ask learners to build, submit, compete, share, or complete a project.

post_types.name: Partner / Sponsor / Instructor Call
post_types.purpose: Feature a sponsor, partner workshop, guest instructor, or contributor need.

post_types.name: Milestone / Wrap-Up / Results
post_types.purpose: Mark cohort progress, completion, certificates, competition results, stars, or growth.

post_types.name: Career / Audience Framing
post_types.purpose: Connect the course to learner backgrounds, role transitions, or job-market context.

post_types.name: Community / Learning In Public
post_types.purpose: Encourage sharing, asking questions, peer review, Slack participation, or public progress.

post_types.name: Companion Offer / Support Layer
post_types.purpose: Explain optional paid or high-touch support while preserving the free course promise.
